title: Falling highs
description: After the first high of 67,805, four lower highs each sit below the one before: 67,288, 66,776, 66,453 and 64,259. The third is a deep bounce that nearly returns to the second, but it stays below it, so the highs keep falling. The latest bounce, to 63,866 so far, is already a fifth lower high, though it may still move up.
